title: Detailed diamond
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='table' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#eaffff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#bfefff'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='crownL' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#9fd8ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#5aa8e8'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='crownR' x1='1' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#7bc0f5'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#3d82c4'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='pavL' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#5fb0ee'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#2f5f9e'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='pavC' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#a8e0ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#4a90d0'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='pavR' x1='1' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#4d94d4'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#22457a'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- crown / top band -->
  <polygon points='20,30 40,30 30,15' fill='#8fd0ff' stroke='#c9f0ff' stroke-width='0.8' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <polygon points='40,30 60,30 50,12' fill='url(#crownL)' stroke='#c9f0ff' stroke-width='0.8' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <polygon points='60,30 80,30 70,16' fill='url(#crownR)' stroke='#c9f0ff' stroke-width='0.8' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <polygon points='20,30 30,15 10,42' fill='url(#crownL)' stroke='#c9f0ff' stroke-width='0.8' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <polygon points='80,30 70,16 90,42' fill='url(#crownR)' stroke='#c9f0ff' stroke-width='0.8' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <polygon points='10,42 20,30 40,30 30,40' fill='#6fb6f0' stroke='#c9f0ff' stroke-width='0.8' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <polygon points='40,30 60,30 50,40 30,40' fill='url(#crownL)' stroke='#c9f0ff' stroke-width='0.8' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <polygon points='60,30 80,30 70,40 50,40' fill='url(#crownR)' stroke='#c9f0ff' stroke-width='0.8' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <polygon points='80,30 90,42 70,40' fill='#3166a8' stroke='#c9f0ff' stroke-width='0.8' stroke-linejoin='round'/>

  <!-- pavilion -->
  <polygon points='30,40 50,40 50,72 22,44' fill='url(#pavL)' stroke='#c9f0ff' stroke-width='0.8' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <polygon points='50,40 70,40 78,44 50,72' fill='url(#pavR)' stroke='#c9f0ff' stroke-width='0.8' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <polygon points='50,40 50,72 22,44 10,42' fill='url(#pavC)' stroke='#c9f0ff' stroke-width='0.8' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <polygon points='50,40 50,72 78,44 90,42' fill='#3a73b4' stroke='#c9f0ff' stroke-width='0.8' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <polygon points='22,44 50,72 10,42' fill='#4d9ade' stroke='#c9f0ff' stroke-width='0.8' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <polygon points='78,44 50,72 90,42' fill='#2c5f9e' stroke='#c9f0ff' stroke-width='0.8' stroke-linejoin='round'/>

  <!-- table facets -->
  <polygon points='30,40 50,40 50,30 40,30' fill='url(#table)' stroke='#e6faff' stroke-width='0.8' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <polygon points='50,40 70,40 60,30 50,30' fill='#d8f4ff' stroke='#e6faff' stroke-width='0.8' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <polygon points='30,40 50,40 10,42 20,30' fill='#b8ecff' stroke='#e6faff' stroke-width='0.8' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <polygon points='50,40 70,40 90,42 80,30' fill='#a0dcf8' stroke='#e6faff' stroke-width='0.8' stroke-linejoin='round'/>

  <!-- glints -->
  <polygon points='47,20 50,14 53,20 50,26' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.95'/>
